title: integration test nits
body:
#### What type of PR is this?

/kind cleanup

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

So I was working of fixing some shellcheck issues and used whatever
bats files I had checked out as a testing base. One of the fixes I made
to shellcheck (https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/pull/3552) found
a real issue with one of the tests:

```bash
run rm -rf $blobcachedir/*
assert "$status" -eq 0 "status of `run rm $cachefile` must be 0"
```

Here `run rm $cachefile` is actually executed, and sets `$status` and `$output`
(also, the error message would be `status of  must be 0`).

So I looked at the code and found some more issues in it.

One of those issues are, you don't have to do something like

```bash
run foo
assert $status -eq 0
```

because you can just call `foo`.

So I looked through the code for similar issues and fixed a few more.
